chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-5 When the 1H NMR spectrum of acetone, CH3COCH3, is recorded on an instrument operating at 200 MHz, a single sharp resonance at 2.1 δ is seen. (a) How many hertz downfield from TMS does the acetone resonance correspond to? (b) If the 1H NMR spectrum of acetone is recorded at 500 MHz, what would the position of the absorption be in δ units? (c) How many hertz downfield from TMS does this 500 MHz resonance correspond to?
